name: com.pay-call/hotlines
title: PayCall hotline data
description: Official hotline numbers and hours with sources, tested phone-menu routes to a person, hold times.

tools.name: search_hotlines
tools.description: Find official customer-service and government hotlines by organisation name ("IRS", "Chase", "HMRC", "Lufthansa") or by phone number, optionally filtered by country, kind and test status. Returns the number, hours, whether it is open now, test status and the id for the other tools.

query.description: Organisation or department name, or a phone number.

country.description: ISO country code, for example us, ca, gb, au, de.

kind.description: Kind of hotline, for example bank, government, airline, insurance.

status.description: tested: phone-menu route on record; checked: test robot recorded the first announcement; listed: official source only.

reachable_from_abroad.description: Only hotlines that PayCall calls from abroad reached.

lang.description: Language of texts such as hours and summaries; English where a translation is missing. Default en.

tools.name: get_hotline
tools.description: Everything PayCall has on one hotline: numbers, hours in text and machine form, the official source with its check date, the newest test call, the phone-menu route, hold times and the guide link. Give id or number.

id.description: Hotline id from search_hotlines, for example "irs".

number.description: Phone number in any format, for example "+1 800-829-1040" or "18008291040".

lang.description: Language of texts such as hours and summaries; English where a translation is missing. Default en.

tools.name: hotline_open_now
tools.description: Whether a hotline is open right now by its published hours, the local time there, and when it next opens or closes. Public holidays are not known. Give id or number.

id.description: Hotline id from search_hotlines, for example "irs".

number.description: Phone number in any format, for example "+1 800-829-1040" or "18008291040".

lang.description: Language of texts such as hours and summaries; English where a translation is missing. Default en.

tools.name: reach_a_person
tools.description: How to get through a hotline's phone menu to a human agent, from PayCall's real test calls: the keys to press and words to say, whether the line insists on account or ID data, what the line says first, the measured hold time and whether calls from abroad connected. Give id or number.

id.description: Hotline id from search_hotlines, for example "irs".

number.description: Phone number in any format, for example "+1 800-829-1040" or "18008291040".

lang.description: Language of texts such as hours and summaries; English where a translation is missing. Default en.
